overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（10 篇）、资产定价（1 篇）、行为金融（1 篇）。方法上以模型校准、贝叶斯方法为主。来源分布：arXiv（12 篇）。

papers.title: Natural Disasters and the Nonprofit Sector
papers.abstract: When natural disasters strike, individuals, communities, and even entire countries can suffer. Researchers have studied the impacts of disasters on various factors of interest, from mental health, to poverty, to economic activity. However, the impact of disasters on the nonprofit sector is understudied despite the nonprofit sector's perhaps surprising role in local or national economies as well as its role in disaster response and recovery. Thus, we study the effect of natural disaster damage on different county-level nonprofit outcomes using a panel dataset spanning 1991 to 2021 and causal inference methods tailored to panel data. Contrary to prior work, which found small but positive associations between disaster damage and nonprofit revenue or assets, we find no evidence of a causal effect.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：研究自然灾害损害对县级非营利部门结果的影响。
🔬 研究方法：使用1991年至2021年的面板数据集，并采用针对面板数据的因果推断方法。
📊 核心发现：与以往发现灾害损害与非营利收入或资产存在正相关关系的研究不同，本文未发现二者之间存在因果效应的证据。
💡 应用价值：填补了关于自然灾害对非营利部门影响的研究空白，为理解非营利部门在灾害应对与恢复中的作用提供了新的实证依据。

papers.title: Global Multi-Maturity SPX-VIX Calibration Beyond Markovian Stitching
papers.abstract: We develop a global framework for joint S&P 500 (SPX)-VIX smile calibration across multiple maturities without the conditional-independence restriction induced by Markovian stitching. Exact local and global feasibility are equivalent: every globally feasible law has a block-preserving SPX-Markovization that leaves each monthly $(S_i,V_i,S_{i+1})$ law unchanged. Nevertheless, stitched laws can form a strict subset of globally feasible path laws because Markovization discards dependence on earlier history beyond the current SPX level. Adjacent smiles therefore cannot identify this dependence, and laws with identical monthly calibrations can price multi-period claims differently. Under the standard Markov reference, relative entropy selects the stitched minimum-information completion; non-Markov dependence requires cross-period information, an appropriate objective, or a history-dependent prior. For finite discretizations, we introduce an augmented-Bregman mirror-descent scheme. It preserves the fit to observable quote moments while controlling martingale and dispersion residuals. In a controlled infeasible affine system, this split keeps prescribed marginals about $25$ times tighter than cyclic row projection by exposing the discrepancy in the conditional rows. An exact finite-state example verifies block preservation and exhibits material cross-period price changes after Markovization. On smoothed SPX and VIX surfaces, numerical calculations illustrate a finite-budget penalty path: the worst fitted-smile error remains below $0.70$ volatility points across the reported sweep while the bulk conditional diagnostics improve substantially.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们构建了一个全球性框架，用于联合校准标普500指数（SPX）与波动率指数（VIX）的微笑曲线（smile curve），涵盖了多种到期时间。该框架无需依赖马尔可夫拼接（Markovian stitching）所带来的条件独立性限制。局部和全局可行性是等价的：每一个全局可行的路径都存在一种保持数据块结构的SPX-Markov化方法，该方法不会改变每个月份的$(S_i,V_i,S_{i+1})$数据序列。然而，通过马尔可夫化处理后的路径可能仅构成全局可行路径的一个严格子集，因为该方法会忽略当前SPX水平之前的历史数据依赖性。因此，相邻的微笑曲线无法反映这种依赖性，具有相同月度校准参数的路径可能会对多期期权定价产生差异。在标准的马尔可夫假设下，相对熵（relative entropy）能够选择信息量最小的拼接路径；而非马尔可夫依赖性则需要跨期信息、合适的优化目标或基于历史数据的先验分布。对于离散化处理，我们提出了一种改进的Bregman镜像下降（augmented-Bregman mirror-descent）算法，该算法在控制鞅性质和价格离散度偏差的同时，仍能保持对可观测报价数据的...。研究方法：模型校准。

papers.title: Tournaments with Managerial Discretion
papers.abstract: We study tournaments with managerial discretion in hiring. A manager selects a coworker from a pool of candidates and then competes against him in a Lazear--Rosen--style tournament with a prize equal to a share of total output. A profit-maximizing principal sets the prize share together with a head start (or handicap)---an advantage (or disadvantage) in the output comparison---granted to the manager. The head start affects output through three channels: (i) encouraging the manager, (ii) discouraging the new hire, and (iii) inducing the manager to hire a stronger candidate. The hiring effect dominates the discouragement effect until the strongest candidate is hired; beyond that point, any further head start discourages the new hire more than it encourages the manager. The optimal contract therefore grants a head start just large enough to induce the manager to hire the strongest candidate.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了在招聘过程中存在管理者自由裁量权的锦标赛机制。管理者从候选人池中挑选一名同事，随后与这名同事参加一场基于Lazear-Rosen模型的锦标赛，比赛奖金等于总产出的某一份额。作为利润最大化的委托人，会设定奖金份额，并同时给予管理者一定的“先发优势”（或称为“劣势”）——即在产出比较中的优势或劣势。这种先发优势通过三个途径影响最终结果：（1）激励管理者；（2）抑制新员工的积极性；（3）促使管理者选择更优秀的候选人。在最强候选人被录用之前，这种先发优势对管理者的激励作用大于对新员工的抑制作用；但超过这一阶段后，任何额外的先发优势都会更多地抑制新员工的积极性而非激励管理者。因此，最优合同应设定适当的先发优势幅度，以促使管理者选择最优秀的候选人。。

papers.title: Bayesian Confidence Recalibration and Research-Equilibrium Criticality: Temporal Support in Robust Portfolios
papers.abstract: Robust portfolio rules that reconstruct confidence sets after learning need not preserve the evaluator obtained by prior-by-prior Bayesian transport. In the Gaussian model, this discrepancy is summarized by natural-coordinate displacement: inherited transport preserves it whereas fresh reconstruction can replace it. We price evaluator replacement and trace the resulting optimized curvature through endogenous research. Optimized robust value represents protocol regret as a functional Bregman divergence, while a within-vintage rectangular Gaussian benchmark with constant absolute risk aversion (CARA) yields a stopped recalibration tax. In a versioned model-release economy, validated history propagates through a strictly causal network and a same-cycle share of current optimized marginal value feeds back into research supply. The capacity-constrained equilibrium reduces to a scalar equation with protocol-indexed gain \(\mathfrak g_I^P=λβ_{R,I}(W_R^P)''\). Purely causal validation cannot create a same-cycle unit mode; provenance changes criticality through optimized curvature. For a scalar primitive supplier-score shock \(z\) in direction \(h_I\) and financial outcome \(\mathcal O\), sensitivity factors as \(ω_{\mathcal O,h,I}/(1-\mathfrak g_I^P)\). Conditional on a smooth equilibrium state and active cell, completion-time information sharply bounds this multiplier when all compatible timing laws are subcritical; no finite uniform bound exists when the timing set reaches the pole.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在机器学习过程中，用于重构置信集的鲁棒投资组合规则并不需要保留通过逐层贝叶斯传输（prior-by-prior Bayesian transport）方法获得的评估结果。在高斯模型中，这种差异可以通过“自然坐标位移”（natural-coordinate displacement）来体现：传统的传输方法会保留这种差异，而新的重构方法则可以消除这种差异。我们对评估结果的替换行为进行了定价分析，并通过内生研究过程追踪了由此产生的优化曲率变化。优化后的鲁棒价值将协议遗憾（protocol regret）表示为一种函数形式的Bregman散度（functional Bregman divergence）；而采用恒定绝对风险厌恶（CARA）假设的矩形高斯基准模型则揭示了一种“停止重新校准”的税收机制（stopped recalibration tax）。在具有版本控制机制的经济环境中，经过验证的历史信息会通过严格的因果网络进行传播，当前优化后的边际价值会在同一周期内反馈到研究供给中。当存在容量限制时，均衡状态可以简化为一个标量方程，其形式为 \(\mathfrak g_I^P=λβ_{R,...。研究方法：贝叶斯方法、模型校准、均衡模型。

papers.title: Proof of Steady-State Multiplicity in Aiyagari
papers.abstract: I provide the first analytic construction of a canonical Aiyagari economy exhibiting at least three steady states. Along the way, I provide new upper and lower bounds on the stationary capital supply for the case where the net return on saving is negative. I also give parameter restrictions that guarantee the existence of a steady state with a rental rate in the neighborhood of a remarkably simple number: the capital share times the depreciation rate.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我首次构建了一个规范的Aiyagari经济模型，并证明了该模型至少存在三个稳态。在此过程中，我针对储蓄净回报为负的情况，提出了关于稳态资本供给的新上界和下界。同时，我还给出了参数限制条件，以确保存在一个稳态，在该稳态中租金率接近一个非常简单的数值：即资本份额乘以折旧率。。

papers.title: An Entropic Factor Model for Robust Portfolio Replication
papers.abstract: Portfolio replication, or the construction of a tradable basket of assets to match the risk-return profile of a target benchmark, is fundamentally an ill-posed inverse problem. When restricted to a subset of available assets, classical variance-minimizing models often yield unstable, over-leveraged portfolios highly vulnerable to market shocks. We propose a unified, two-stage methodology rooted in information theory to achieve robust portfolio replication. First, we model the constituent asset returns against target factors, estimating parameters within data-driven empirical bounds via an entropy minimization principle. Second, using the same entropic approach, we determine the optimal weight replication. In both cases we use an entropy function of the Fermi-Dirac type defined directly on sets of constraints of the inverse problem. We validate this Entropic Factor Model (EFM) against standard Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) across five numerical experiments, including standard equity tracking, multi-asset synthesis, and severe stress-test scenarios. Empirical results demonstrate that the EFM consistently outperforms OLS in terms of annualized turnover and net-of-fees returns. Crucially, during the COVID-19 market crash and under severe idiosyncratic data corruption, the entropic framework acts as a probabilistic ``circuit breaker", defensively reducing capital allocation to compromised assets and providing a highly robust, risk-averse solution for generalized portfolio replication.
papers.summary_zh: 【资产定价】投资组合复制（即构建一个可交易的资产组合以匹配目标基准的风险-回报特征）本质上是一个病态的逆问题。当仅使用可用资产的一个子集时，传统的方差最小化模型往往会产生不稳定、杠杆率过高的投资组合，这些投资组合极易受到市场冲击的影响。我们提出了一种基于信息论的统一两阶段方法来实现稳健的投资组合复制。首先，我们根据目标因子对构成资产的表现进行建模，并通过熵最小化原理在数据驱动的实证范围内估计参数；其次，同样利用熵方法来确定最优权重配置。在这两个阶段中，我们都使用了一种直接定义在逆问题约束集上的费米-狄拉克型熵函数。我们通过五个数值实验（包括标准股票跟踪、多资产合成以及极端压力测试场景）对这种熵因子模型（EFM）与传统的普通最小二乘法（OLS）进行了对比验证。实证结果表明，EFM在年化周转率和净费用回报方面始终优于OLS。特别是在COVID-19市场崩盘期间以及数据严重失真的情况下，熵框架起到了概率性的“断路器”作用，能够主动减少对受损资产的资本配置，从而为广义投资组合复制提供高度稳健、风险规避的解决方案。。研究方法：实验方法、因子模型。

papers.title: Knowledge-Based Mechanisms
papers.abstract: We study robust mechanisms when the designer possesses a Bayesian belief over some components of agents' private information but faces ambiguity over others. The designer evaluates mechanisms by their worst-case performance over all joint distributions consistent with her belief over the Bayesian components. The framework encompasses settings such as multidimensional delegation in which a principal knows the distribution of the state but not the agent's preferences (e.g., his tradeoffs across dimensions), screening in which a seller only has misspecified estimates of buyer preferences, and auction and voting design when agents' beliefs about each other are ambiguous to the designer. We provide conditions under which a \emph{knowledge-based} mechanism---one that conditions only on the Bayesian components but not the ambiguous ones---is robustly optimal. Our results unify earlier work across distinct economic environments and uncover new applications.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：研究设计者在部分信息上拥有贝叶斯信念、而在其他信息上面临模糊性时的稳健机制设计问题。

🔬 研究方法：通过评估机制在所有与贝叶斯信念一致的联合分布中的最坏情况表现来进行稳健性分析。

📊 核心发现：提供了条件，使得仅依赖于贝叶斯组成部分而非模糊部分的“基于知识的机制”是稳健最优的。

💡 应用价值：该框架涵盖了多维委托、筛选、拍卖和投票设计等场景，统一了不同经济环境下的先前工作并发现了新的应用。

papers.title: Randomization Inference for Matched Pairs with Binary Outcomes
papers.abstract: We give an exact randomization-based confidence set for the average treatment effect (ATE) in matched-pair studies with a binary outcome, requiring neither monotonicity nor any distributional assumption beyond the within-pair coin flip. At its core is an analytic solution to the worst-case allocation of attributable effects: two binomial-symmetry lemmas identify the pattern hardest to reject as a single boundary corner, so testing null hypotheses needs no integer program and no numerical search. Inverting the test via binary search yields a prediction set for the attributable effect in O(log S) Binomial tail calculations; the Bonferroni proposition of Rigdon and Hudgens (2015) produces the ATE confidence set at the same computational cost. The same corner extends without further machinery to a sensitivity analysis for matched observational studies under Rosenbaum's $Γ$-model. A simple formula for the design sensitivity illuminates when an observational study can hope to provide evidence for an effect.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们为具有二元结果的配对研究中平均处理效应（ATE）提供了一个基于精确随机化的置信集，该置信集的构建既不需要数据单调性，也不需要对数据分布做出任何额外假设（仅需满足配对内部数据服从均匀分布）。其核心思想是对“最坏情况下的效应分配”问题提供了解析解：两个与二项式对称性相关的引理帮助我们识别出最难被拒绝的数据分布模式（即该模式对应于某个特定的边界角）；因此，检验原假设时既无需使用整数规划算法，也无需进行数值搜索。通过二分搜索来反转这种检验方法，可以在 O(log S) 的计算时间内得到效应的预测区间；Rigdon 和 Hudgens（2015）提出的 Bonferroni 定理同样可以在相同的计算成本下生成 ATE 的置信集。这一方法无需额外工具即可应用于 Rosenbaum 的 $Γ$-模型框架下的配对观察性研究，从而实现对研究敏感性的分析。此外，一个简单的设计敏感性公式有助于判断观察性研究在何种情况下能够为效应的存在提供有力证据。。

papers.title: The Analyst in the Prompt: Role, Retrieval, and Memory Biases in LLM Financial Analysis
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly use user context such as memory, profiles, and role prompts to personalize their responses. This personalization can affect evidence-based judgment: the same evidence may lead to different conclusions under different user contexts. Finance provides a high-stakes setting to study this problem because decisions often depend on interpreting long and complex documents. We test this using 3,575 SEC filings across twelve LLMs. We compare persona-conditioned retrieval, neutral retrieval, and memory-framed context to separate the effect of evidence selection from the effect of interpretation. We find that most user-context spillover comes from how models interpret the same evidence under different roles, rather than from retrieving different evidence. We then test two simple mitigation strategies: expressing the same investor mindset as a user profile instead of an assistant role, and separating evidence-based and personalized outputs. Both reduce spillover, but neither removes it completely, and their effectiveness varies substantially across models.
papers.summary_zh: 【行为金融】大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地利用用户上下文信息（如用户记忆、个人资料和角色提示）来个性化其响应。这种个性化处理可能会影响基于证据的判断：在不同的用户背景下，相同的证据可能会得出不同的结论。金融领域为研究这一问题提供了高风险的环境，因为金融决策往往依赖于对冗长复杂文档的解读。我们通过分析3,575份美国证券交易委员会（SEC）的文件，在12种LLMs上验证了这一现象。我们对比了基于用户角色定制的检索结果、中性检索结果以及以用户记忆为框架的检索结果，以区分证据选择的影响与文档解读的影响。研究发现，用户上下文对模型判断的影响主要源于模型在不同角色下对相同信息的解读方式，而非检索到不同的证据。随后，我们测试了两种简单的缓解策略：一是将投资者的思维方式通过用户个人资料而非助手角色来表达；二是将基于证据的输出与个性化输出分开呈现。这两种策略都能减少上下文对模型判断的干扰，但都无法完全消除这种影响，且其效果因模型而异。。研究方法：大语言模型。

papers.title: Mean-field equilibrium of heterogeneous agents under market impact
papers.abstract: Although market participants generally have access to a common information set, they make decisions based on forecasts formed over heterogeneous horizons. Because market impact depends on aggregate positions rather than trader identities, these decisions feed back into prices through their collective effect. We introduce a linear mean-field model of this interaction. The observed price is decomposed into a martingale component, a common predictable signal represented by a Volterra process, and the market impact generated by aggregate positions. Agents take positions according to conditional forecasts of future signal increments and a fraction of anticipated aggregate impact over their respective horizons. Within a Gaussian-Volterra framework, we characterize equilibrium through a linear fixed-point equation for aggregate positions and establish existence and uniqueness under explicit conditions. At equilibrium, we identify a balance condition that cancels the direct transmission of the common signal to the observed price. We then study the limit in which agents fully account for market impact. Along a suitably scaled family of equilibria satisfying explicit conditions, the contributions of the predictable signal and the market impact cancel in the limit, and the observed price converges to its martingale component. For fractional-type signals and Gamma-distributed horizons, we further derive local Hölder bounds and identify the horizon distributions for which the observed price has local regularity compatible with that of Brownian motion.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】尽管市场参与者通常能够获取相同的信息集，但他们基于不同时间范围内的预测来做出决策。由于市场影响取决于总体持仓情况而非交易者的身份，这些决策会通过其集体效应反馈到价格中。我们提出了一个描述这种互动的线性平均场模型。观察到的价格可以分解为三个部分：一个鞅成分、一个由Volterra过程表示的、可预测的公共信号，以及由总体持仓情况产生的市场影响。代理人根据对未来信号增量的条件预测以及他们各自时间范围内预期市场影响的比例来制定持仓策略。在高斯-Volterra框架下，我们通过一个关于总体持仓的线性不动点方程来描述均衡状态，并在明确条件下证明了均衡的存在性和唯一性。在均衡状态下，我们发现了一个平衡条件，该条件消除了公共信号对观察价格的直接影响。随后，我们研究了代理人完全考虑市场影响时的极限情况。在满足明确条件的一系列适当缩放的均衡状态下，可预测信号和市场影响的贡献在极限情况下相互抵消，观察到的价格趋于其鞅成分。对于分数型信号和Gamma分布的时间范围，我们进一步推导出了局部Hölder界限，并确定了观察到的价格具有与布朗运动相容的局部规律性的时间范围分布。。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: Scaling Laws, Tabular Data and Actuarial Ratemaking Models
papers.abstract: Scaling laws in modern deep learning describe how held-out loss improves as model capacity, training data, and compute increase, often following power-law trends. We investigate whether analogous scaling regularities arise in actuarial ratemaking, where data are tabular, heterogeneous, and noisy, and where classical models such as GLMs remain strong baselines. Using a real-world motor insurance portfolio, we train models from different families across increasing fractions of the training data and multiple random seeds, evaluating out-of-sample Poisson deviance, a likelihood-based loss for Poisson count predictions in which lower values indicate better held-out fit. We find that all model families improve with additional data, but scaling exponents differ substantially: TabM exhibits markedly stronger data scaling than purely supervised tabular Transformers and standard MLP baselines. Transformer variants show weak parameter scaling unless augmented with additional inductive biases (TabM-style adaptation or self-supervision). These results provide quantitative guidance on model selection by data regime and suggest that effective scaling on actuarial tabular tasks depends on architecture and loss function objective design, with simple increases in Transformer size providing limited gains.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】现代深度学习中的尺度律描述了随着模型容量、训练数据和计算资源的增加，模型在未见过数据上的表现（即“保留损失”）如何得到提升，这种提升通常遵循幂律趋势。我们研究了在精算费率制定领域是否存在类似的尺度规律。在精算领域，数据以表格形式存在，具有异质性和噪声特性，而传统的模型（如广义线性模型GLMs）仍然是强有力的基准模型。我们使用了一个真实的汽车保险数据集，训练了多种不同类型的模型，并使用了不同比例的训练数据以及多个随机种子进行实验。评估指标是样本外的泊松偏差（Poisson Deviance），这是一种基于似然的损失函数，用于预测泊松分布下的数据数量；其中较小的偏差值表示模型对未见过数据的拟合效果更好。研究发现，所有模型类型在数据量增加时性能都有所提升，但它们的尺度指数存在显著差异：TabM模型在数据扩展能力上明显优于纯监督学习的表格模型和标准的MLP模型。除非通过额外的归纳偏见（如TabM风格的调整或自我监督机制）进行增强，否则Transformer变体的参数扩展能力较弱。这些结果为根据数据特性选择模型提供了定量指导，并表明在精算表格任务中实现有效的模型扩展依赖于模型架构和损失函数...。研究方法：深度学习、Transformer 模型。

papers.title: Tempting the Agent: The Economics of Reputation without Persistent Identity in AI Agent Markets
papers.abstract: Reputation is a fundamental mechanism through which markets sustain trust when service quality cannot be perfectly assessed ex ante, constituting a form of intertemporal economic capital by attracting future demand. Its effectiveness as a disciplinary mechanism depends not only on past interactions but also on the persistence of the identity to which reputation is attached. When identities can be abandoned and recreated cheaply, reputational capital may itself become an object of opportunistic exploitation.   This paper develops a dynamic economic framework to study when reputation is sufficient to discipline autonomous agents. We model reputation as capital attracting future economic activity. At each point, an agent chooses between operating honestly, investing in quality to preserve future gains, or executing a one-shot deviation to extract its reputation's value and restart from a penalized identity. Our analysis relates the temptation to opportunistic behavior to identity-reset costs, reputation persistence, demand sensitivity, and enforcement design, deriving comparative statics on optimal quality provision.   Autonomous AI-agent operating on the blockchain are a relevant application: infrastructures such as ERC-8004, ERC-8183, and x402 combine reputation, identity, and payments in permissionless markets. Nonetheless, our framework applies to any environment where reputation generates future business and identities are replaceable.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】声誉是市场在无法事先完全评估服务质量时维持信任的一种基本机制，它通过吸引未来的需求，构成了一种跨时期的经济资本。作为一种约束机制，声誉的有效性不仅取决于过去的互动，还取决于与其相关联的身份的持久性。当身份可以廉价地被抛弃和重新创建时，声誉资本本身也可能成为机会主义剥削的对象。本文构建了一个动态经济框架，用以研究在何种情况下声誉足以对自主代理进行约束。我们将声誉视为一种能够吸引未来经济活动的资本。在每个决策时刻，代理需要在三种选择之间进行抉择：一是诚实经营、投资于质量以保持未来的收益；二是进行一次性违规行为以获取声誉的价值，然后从受到惩罚的身份重新开始；三是放弃当前的身份。我们的分析将机会主义行为的诱惑与身份重置成本、声誉的持久性、需求敏感度以及执行机制的设计联系起来，并据此推导出关于最优质量提供的比较静态结果。在区块链上运行的自主AI代理是一个相关的应用案例：诸如ERC-8004、ERC-8183和x402等基础设施在无需许可的市场中整合了声誉、身份和支付功能。尽管如此，我们的框架适用于任何声誉能够带来未来业务机会且身份可以被替代的环境。。
